text:
maria.reps: Heads-up — Verdant Systems' exec committee put their POC on hold until we provide a signed data-residency attestation + a concrete pilot spend cap. They want CTO/CISO call before PO. Can Eng/Sec join a quick sync today?

dan.presales: I can. Do we have a short attestation template or do Legal want custom wording? Also need to confirm whether the spend cap is weekly or total for the 30-day trial.

lee.security: We have a one-pager we can adapt: region guarantee, no outbound raw-data egress without approval, audit log retention. Need to confirm KMS preference (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and if they require dedicated HSM certs.

jon.eng: For a Dedicated VPC pilot we can provision within 72 hours. On-prem will add several weeks (procurement + install). Also note: if they require model pinning + quantization for their regs, we'll need a quick compatibility run against their sample set.

tara.csm: Customer explicitly asked for a hard ceiling on pilot spend for procurement sign-off. They mentioned "no surprises" in the PO. Finance needs to sign any cap. I can surface exec sponsor if we have the signed attestation.

dan.presales: Draft pricing suggestion: 30-day pilot, Dedicated VPC, optional BYOK, pilot spend cap $6,000 total or $0.0009/token on excess (whichever favors customer). Can Rev/Finance confirm?

lee.security: That seems reasonable to present as a proposal. Draft attestation below (legal review required):

lee.security: ```
Data Residency Attestation (draft)
- All customer data processed only in region: us-east-2.
- No extraction or export of raw data outside the region without express customer approval.
- Customer may elect BYOK; Redwood will support both customer-managed keys or Redwood KMS with HSM.
- Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days and available for customer review.
```

maria.reps: Good. @triage-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvals and owners.

triage-bot: Ticket created: SD-2041 (Verdant POC BoardApproval). Owners: dan.presales, lee.security, legal-team.

jon.eng: Risk note: if they require deterministic responses from a pinned model variant, throughput tuning + cache warming may change latency. Recommend a 1-hour validation run with their sample corpus before exec call. Who can add samples to secure share?

tara.csm: I'll upload a sanitized sample set now and add Eng + Sec.

dan.presales: Finance/Rev — can you confirm the $6k total cap for 30 days? If we can't do that, what's the fallback (higher cap or %) so I can communicate? @finance-team

maria.reps: Plan (if Finance OK): 1) Send draft attestation + pricing to customer today, 2) schedule 30m call with their CTO/CISO + our execs tomorrow, 3) run quick compatibility test once samples are in. Target: board sign-off by Friday EOD.

lee.security: Legal asked we include an addendum: "Redwood will provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal eyes now.

jon.eng: Reserving a staging Dedicated cluster slot. If BYOK, start KMS onboarding paperwork (24-48h).

tara.csm: Customer prefers VPC for pilot unless audit requires on-prem. I'll confirm this in DM.

dan.presales: 2pm tomorrow best for me to do the exec touchpoint. Maria, Tara, Lee, Jon — can you make that?

maria.reps: I can. Lee?

lee.security: 2pm works.

jon.eng: 2pm is fine, I'll be on standby after validation run.

triage-bot: SD-2041 status updated -> "awaiting legal review"

maria.reps: Thanks everyone. I'll push the draft to Legal now and post the signed attestation here when available. Customer said "no signed attestation, no PO" — so let's prioritize.

dan.presales: I'll draft a short SLA addendum in case procurement requests a brief uptime/response commitment for the pilot. Will attach to the attestation when Legal gives the go-ahead.

lee.security: One more ask: confirm whether Verdant requires physical air-gapped on-prem. If not, Dedicated/VPC keeps timeline fast.

tara.csm: DM from customer: on-prem only if required by audit. Otherwise they'd prefer VPC pilot. Updating them with our draft and the tentative 2pm slot. :thumbsup:

maria.reps: Closing the loop — Legal review started. Will update ticket SD-2041 and ping if we need exec intro sooner. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
